text: Anndee pellet, nguurndam aduna ɗamko fijindaaru e mbeleeɗe. Haqqiloowo non sokolirtaa ɗum gaay e laakara. Hara le si on gomɗinii Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on, on hulirii Allah ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko ɗin woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, O yeɗiray on njoɓdi golle mon ɗen no timmiri, O lamndotaa- ko on jawle mon ɗen fow, ko yeru ko waɗɗii kon e Zakka tun O lamndii on.
